notes.content:

The Ship’s Log: Course Set

The ship knows where it’s headed. Here’s what it’s whispering to us:


June: You’ll see the first movements - gameplay surfaces.
July: Weapons systems come online - combat revealed.
August: New crew wanted - closed alpha sign-ups.
Fall: The ship grows - more rooms, more threats, more secrets.


Plans may change if the ship decides otherwise. Stay tuned.
